concerns.text: FR-001 mandates extending '16 existing EvoPolicyGym environments.' Task T015 only creates a 'wrapper script' to apply logic, lacking a specific task to implement the subclassing or modification logic for the 16 distinct environments. This silently relaxes the requirement to a single generic implementation, leaving the core scope unaddressed.

Task ID T024 is duplicated: first as a test for US2 (schema validation), then as an implementation task for US2 (suppressing generation for successes). This ID collision breaks traceability and risks the 'suppress generation for successes' acceptance criterion (US2, Scenario 2) being dropped or unverified.

FR-003 requires executing the harness on 'both the baseline (scalar reward) and counterfactual conditions.' Task T026 only mentions creating the 'EvolutionaryHarness' class without a specific task to implement the dual-condition execution flow or the baseline logic, risking a silent omission of the control group.

US1 Independent Test requires verifying a 'statistically significant performance drop (p < 0.05).' Task T014 only logs a warning if the drop is not significant; no task exists to implement the statistical test logic (e.g., t-test) required to perform this verification, violating the acceptance criterion.

FR-002 and US2 require the explanation to identify the 'required correction' based on 'ground-truth environment rules.' Task T022 implements 'deterministic rule mapping' but lacks a prerequisite task to load/parse the 'ground-truth environment rules' (JSON schema), making the mapping logic impossible to implement as specified.
